title: Tier 1: Foundation
description: Learn what you can lose before what you can gain: a clean line chart, plain-English market orders and a one-tap safety net.
features: Clean line chart (the future stays hidden)
One-tap safety net when a position is down 8%

title: Tier 2: Tactical Protection
description: Take control of your protection: limit orders, safety nets you size yourself and the highs and lows so far.
features: Choose how far the price may fall before your safety net sells
High and low so far marked on the chart
how_to_unlock: Answer the quick check after your first trade correctly.

title: Tier 3: Strategic Mastery
description: Read the market in more detail: candlesticks, stop orders and a precomputed moving-average strategy.
how_to_unlock: Set a safety net, then answer the stop-loss check correctly.
